create_HFShard: create an HFShard instance wrapping a HuggingFace dataset for use with stopes Shard and Mapper API
use_HFShard_context_manager: use HFShard as a context manager to load and iterate over a HuggingFace dataset with caching
iterate_HFShard_to_batches: iterate over an HFShard using to_batches to yield Arrow-formatted batches with optional column projection
create_HFInputConfig: create an HFInputConfig to configure HuggingFace dataset sharding with split, caching, and trust_remote_code options
call_HFInputConfig_make_shards: call make_shards on HFInputConfig to generate a list of HFShard instances for parallel processing
